name: OSV Agent
description: OSV vulnerability lookup agent that analyzes packages and provides plain-language summaries of vulnerabilities, affected versions, severity, and references. Additionally it will trigger further steps to notify the appropriate system owners based on the affected systems.

skills.name: Get OSV Report
skills.description: Exposes OSV vulnerability lookup: accepts a GHSA id and returns a plain-language summary of packages, affected versions, severity, and references for downstream matching.
examples: Analyze the vulnerability report for GHSA-vgqx-447m-wvcj and summarize the affected packages and versions.
